title: 第14章 王春晓的回报-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》
content:
第(1/3)页

    趟子房外的篝火燃烧，透过房门照亮了狭小趟子房，王春晓坐在干草上，脸上微微流露出一抹痛苦之色。

    “你……脱我袜子干嘛？”

    王春晓见李青山竟然将自己的袜子给褪了下来，面色微微一红，浑身忍不住一僵，身体失去了控制动弹不得，一脸懵逼，盯着李青山有些不知所措。

    “你不是脚崴了吗？”

    李青山一边说着，一边将王春晓的袜子褪了下来，露出一只白嫩的小脚，脚趾粉嫩。

    少女的玉足，宛若夏日雪糕。

    这句话在李青山面前，具象化了。

    李青山粗糙宽厚的大手，将小巧的玉足全部握在掌心之中，一股温热和安全的感觉包裹着王春晓的小脚。

    刚开始的时候。

    王春晓有些放不开和羞涩，毕竟自己一个黄花大闺女，连男人的手都没有碰过，什么时候让男人碰到如此令人羞耻的地方？

    但是。

    当李青山粗糙宽厚的大手掌，包裹着自己的小脚不断按捏的时候，安全感和舒爽的感觉一起袭来，让原本疼痛的脚腕逐渐褪去了疼痛，转而的是一种享受的感觉。

    但是，少女的羞涩，却并未褪去。

    双手撑地，低着头，身体微微后仰，脸蛋上的娇羞和红晕甚是迷人。

    皓齿轻咬下嘴唇。

    多了几分迷人的少女姿态。

    道医传承中，除了开方子，十三针之外，还有就是推拿，这也属于道医的传承，有很多常年淤积的病症，就需要推拿。

    还有自己的炼体术，并不是单独出来的。

    而是属于道医传承内的，算是养生术，养生拳……！

    后来。

    自己跟着老道士的时候，没少看武侠小说，为了让自己在这方面刻苦，老道士便告诉自己这是武林秘籍，炼体术，练成了就是武侠小说中的大侠。

    推拿一道，若是学好了。

    是可以出神医的。

    王春晓这一路走来，到处山地，双脚早已超出了本来应该承受的极限，只要休息一晚上，第二天疼痛和疲惫就会出现。

    自己现在的推拿，就是为了王春晓缓解脚上的疼痛。

    “咔嚓！”

    紧接着。

    一道骨头清脆的声音响起，王春晓的脚腕被李青山接好，李青山转了转王春晓的小脚，开口道：“来，站起来试试！”

    “啊？”

    王春晓微微一怔，旋即眉头微蹙道：“我……我脚疼……！”

    “无碍，你试试！”李青山肯定道。

    王春晓听了李青山的话后，半信半疑的从干枯的稻草上站了起来，崴的右脚小心翼翼落在地上，然后用力……！

    咦！！

    王春晓突然发现自己崴的那只脚，竟然不疼了。

    “李青山？这是怎么回事？”

    “难道，你还会医术？”

    “不可能啊，在村里的时候，没听说过啊……！”

    王春晓脸上流露出一抹震惊之色，望着眼前的李青山道。

    “老林子里面有个老大夫，当初和他学过一段时间，后来这老大夫就去云游了。”

    “你这双脚是走了不少的路吧？”

    “一个人怎么跑到这里的？可以说说了吧？”

    李青山望着眼前的王春晓，开口问道：“先坐下，我给你揉一揉，不然等到明天，你这双脚估计会又疼又肿。”

    王春晓听话的重新坐在枯草上，似乎有些难言之隐，但最终还是开口道：“我爹打算让我嫁给赵霸，我不愿意就偷偷跑了出来，结果不小心在老林子里面迷了路，就只能在老林子里面漫无目的的找路，谁曾想晚上还遇到了野狼，若不是你及时出现，我恐怕已经死了。”

    “赵霸？”

    “那不是咱们村支书的儿子吗？”

    “怎么，你不愿意？”

    李青山一边说着，一边将王春晓的另外一只袜子也脱了下来，粗糙宽厚的大手包裹着王春晓的小脚道。

    “当然不愿意了。”

    “我要是愿意的话，怎么可能还跑出来。”

    “又怎么可能还会在老林子里面迷路。”

    王春晓有些赌气道。

    “可是，你有没有想过，你要是不回去的话，还能去哪里？”李青山问道。

    “这……！”

    “我不知道，我就感觉走到哪里就是哪里，反正别管哪里，都比嫁给赵霸那个人强！”

    王春晓一副天不怕地不怕的模样道。

    “王春晓，这里是老林子，除了咱俩就没有其他人了，我是个男人，你是个姿色不错的姑娘，还是个黄花大闺女。”

    “你说，我要是在这里要了你的身子，会有人知道吗？”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

The bonfire outside the house was burning, illuminating the small house through the door. Wang Chunxiao was sitting on the hay, with a slight look of pain on his face.

"Why...are you taking off my socks?"

Wang Chunxiao saw that Li Qingshan had actually taken off his socks, his face turned slightly red, and he couldn't help but stiffen. He lost control of his body and couldn't move. He looked confused and stared at Li Qingshan at a loss.

"Aren't you sprained in your ankle?"

As Li Qingshan spoke, he took off Wang Chunxiao's socks, revealing a white and tender foot with pink toes.

The girl’s jade feet are like summer ice cream.

This sentence became concrete in front of Li Qingshan.

Li Qingshan’s rough and generous hands held all the small feet in his palm, and a feeling of warmth and security enveloped Wang Chunxiao’s little feet.

When I first started.

Wang Chunxiao is a little reluctant and shy. After all, she is a young girl who has never even touched a man's hand. When did she let a man touch such a shameful place?

but.

When Li Qingshan’s rough and generous palms wrapped around his little feet and squeezed them continuously, a sense of security and comfort came over him. The pain in his originally painful ankles gradually faded away, and instead became a feeling of enjoyment.

"However, the girl's shyness has not faded.

He put his hands on the ground, lowered his head, and leaned back slightly. The shyness and blush on his face was very charming.

He bit his lower lip lightly with his white teeth.

It has a bit more charming girlish attitude.

In the inheritance of Taoist medicine, in addition to prescribing prescriptions and thirteen needles, there is also massage. This is also the inheritance of Taoist medicine. There are many diseases that have been accumulated all year round, which require massage.

He also has his own body-refining technique, which is not unique.

It belongs to the inheritance of Taoist medicine, which is regarded as health-preserving technique, health-preserving boxing...!

Later.

When I followed the old Taoist priest, I often read martial arts novels. In order to make myself work hard in this area, the old Taoist priest told myself that these were martial arts secrets and body refining techniques, and after practicing them, I became the hero in the martial arts novels.

​​If you learn a massage well.

It is possible to have a miracle doctor.

Wang Chunxiao’s journey along the way was full of mountainous terrain, and his feet had already exceeded the limit they should have endured. As long as he rested for one night, pain and fatigue would appear the next day.

The massage I am doing now is to relieve the pain in Wang Chunxiao’s feet.

"Click!"

Immediately afterwards.

There was a crisp sound of bones, and Wang Chunxiao's ankle was connected by Li Qingshan. Li Qingshan turned Wang Chunxiao's little foot and said, "Come on, stand up and try!"

"Huh?"

Wang Chunxiao was slightly startled, then frowned slightly and said, "I...my feet hurt...!"

"It's okay, you can try it!" Li Qingshan affirmed.

After listening to Li Qingshan’s words, Wang Chunxiao stood up from the dry straw with hesitation, Wei’s right foot carefully landed on the ground, and then used force...!

Hey!!

Wang Chunxiao suddenly found that his sprained foot no longer hurt.

"Li Qingshan? What's going on?"

"Could it be that you also have medical skills?"

"It's impossible. I never heard of it when I was in the village...!"

Wang Chunxiao had a look of shock on his face and looked at Li Qingshan in front of him.

"There is an old doctor in the old forest. I studied with him for a while, but later the old doctor went to wander around."

"You've traveled a lot with your feet, haven't you?"

"How did a person get here? Can you tell me?"

Li Qingshan looked at Wang Chunxiao in front of him and asked, "Sit down first and I'll rub it for you. Otherwise, your feet will probably be sore and swollen until tomorrow."

Wang Chunxiao sat down on the withered grass again obediently. It seemed that he had some words to hide, but he finally said: "My father planned to let me marry Zhao Ba, but I ran out secretly because I didn't want to. As a result, I accidentally got lost in the old forest, so I could only find my way aimlessly in the old forest. Who would have thought that I would encounter a wild wolf at night. If you hadn't appeared in time, I would have died."

"Zhao Ba?"

"Isn't that the son of our village party secretary?"

"What, you don't want to?"

As Li Qingshan spoke, he took off Wang Chunxiao's other sock, and wrapped his rough and generous hands around Wang Chunxiao's little feet.

"Of course I don't want to."

"If I wanted to, how could I still run out?"

"How could I still get lost in the old forest?"

Wang Chunxiao said with some anger.

"But, have you ever thought about where else you could go if you don't go back?" Li Qingshan asked.

"This...!"

“I don’t know, I just feel like it’s wherever I go. No matter where I go, it’s better than marrying that person Zhao Ba!”

Wang Chunxiao said as if he was not afraid of anything.

"Wang Chunxiao, this is the old forest. There is no one else but the two of us. I am a man and you are a pretty girl and a young lady."

"You said, if I took your body here, would anyone know?"
